title: MQDEsys JobSpec
description: The JSON/YAML document POSTed to /api/v1/jobs (T-1305, the minimal slice of T-0007 needed by the new-job wizard, T-1304). This documents the contract; the authoritative runtime enforcement stays in mqde::planner::validate_jobspec (cpp/src/planner/validate.cpp), which this schema does not replace -- validate_jobspec checks things (recipe/algorithm names, calibration requirements, export compatibility) that depend on data loaded at runtime (data/recipes, data/algorithms.yaml, data/compat/matrix.yaml) and cannot be expressed as a static schema. This schema instead catches structural mistakes early (wrong types, missing essential fields) and is the source the frontend TS type (web/src/types/job_spec.ts) and Python example validation (scripts/validate_job_schema.py) are kept in sync with. Deliberately permissive (additionalProperties: true almost everywhere) so it does not reject fields this slice has not enumerated yet; the two real example fixtures (examples/jobs/*.yaml) and the live NewJob.tsx submission are what this schema was written against, not the other way around.

domain.description: Optional (T-1301). One of the registered data/domains/*.yaml ids. Omitted today by every existing caller, which key off model.type instead; present so T-1304's wizard has somewhere to put the user's explicit domain choice without a breaking change.

quantized_path.description: T-xxxx: an already-quantized checkpoint to evaluate instead of quantizing model.path again. LLM only. When present, omit the quantize stage (and `quant`).

quant_format.description: T-xxxx: how model.quantized_path stores its weights: auto (detect from config.json) or awq | gptq | compressed-tensors | gguf | fp8 | bitsandbytes.

model.description: `path` is the base model to quantize; an evaluate-only job may leave it empty and name model.quantized_path / artifact instead (the tokenizer is read from the checkpoint when it carries one).

stages.description: T-xxxx: pipeline stages to run. Absent keeps the historical all-in-one pipeline. When present it is authoritative: [quantize] writes no reusable checkpoint unless export is also listed; [quantize, export] quantizes and writes a checkpoint without evaluating it; [evaluate] evaluates model.quantized_path or artifact without quantizing; deploy needs an export or an existing checkpoint plus a serving backend.

group_size.description: T-1304: advanced per-job override of every picked recipe's own per_group group_size (the wizard's '高级参数' panel). Read by llm_job.py/vla_job.py; a no-op (logged, not an error) for any recipe whose weight granularity isn't per_group.

custom_samples.description: Calibration text pasted into the form instead of naming a dataset (LLM jobs only; the executor reads it in mqde.data.text.calib_batches and it wins over calibration.dataset). A list of strings, each a sample; blank ones are dropped and at least one must have text. planner::validate_jobspec checks this.

max_new_tokens.description: VLM: longest answer generated per question (vlm_job.py).

suite.description: Offline benchmark suite from data/datasets/eval_suites.yaml (quick|standard) or a path to a suite YAML.

benchmarks.description: Offline benchmarks to run with the checkpoint (names, JSONL paths, or comma-separated names). No serving backend is required for ppl/mcq/qa benchmarks.

sample_steps.description: World/EWM: diffusion sampling steps for the FP reference and every recipe.

action_conditioned.description: World/EWM: evaluation clips carry per-frame actions (EWM sets this automatically).

action_dim.description: World/EWM: action vector width for action-conditioned samples.

device.description: T-1304/T-1306: the evaluation device, independent of the top-level quant_device. Read by llm_job.py (LLMJobSpec.eval_device); falls back to deploy.device when absent, so a job that only sets deploy.device is unaffected. Through mqde serve, this is the same 'cpu'|'gpu' symbol deploy.device already uses -- JobRunner resolves it against whichever GPU pool slot it assigns (or reserves one specially for it even when deploy.device is 'cpu'). A direct `python -m mqde.pipeline.llm_job` invocation may instead use a literal torch device string. VLA (vla_job.py) does not read this yet.

quant_device.description: T-1304/T-1306: the device the quantization stage itself runs on, independent of evaluation.device. Read by llm_job.py (LLMJobSpec.quant_device); falls back to deploy.device when absent. Through mqde serve this is the same 'cpu'|'gpu' symbol deploy.device already uses (JobRunner resolves it, see evaluation.device's description); a direct CLI invocation may use a literal torch device string instead. VLA (vla_job.py) does not read this yet.

backend.description: T-1304: explicit backend choice (hf_transformers | vllm | sglang | llama.cpp); today's export.formats / deploy.llamacpp / deploy.vllm are set independently of this field.

evalscope.description: Benchmark accuracy through the official evalscope CLI (external, optional; skipped when not installed). Same OpenAI-compatible server as lm_eval.

sweep.description: Concurrency sweep on the running vLLM server.

sglang.description: T-0704: serve each exported checkpoint with SGLang (own environment, MQDE_SGLANG_PYTHON), smoke it, load-test it and score it with its own logprobs. Read by llm_job.py; incompatible with evaluation.skip.

lm_eval.description: Task accuracy through the official lm-eval CLI against the SGLang OpenAI-compatible server.

evalscope.description: Benchmark accuracy through the official evalscope CLI against the SGLang server.

sweep.description: Concurrency sweep on the running SGLang server.

native.description: VLA / WM / EWM native continuous-output serving: loopback /v1/actions or /v1/video, smoke + load test on the in-memory quantized model.
